The reward in WETH is calculated as collectedWethAmount * collectRewardPercent / FEE_SCALE (scale of thousand).dev reward is not immediately transferred, but locked for a period of time (devRewardsCliff) in a lock position NFT. The lock NFT is transferred to the dev, so they can unclock the reward, once the lock expires.
